description: Which tests cover which supported configuration. Every model card, backend, device and precision the runtime supports is listed with the tiers that exercise it. Cheap tiers run on every change; expensive ones are reserved for specific events instead of running every combination on every PR. Rendered into docs/test-matrix.md by tools/test_matrix.py.

unit.when: every push and PR (Lint and CPU unit tests; Package)
unit.runs: pytest tests/unit: argument validation, variant selection, downloads and backend wiring for every configuration, against fakes; the llm-unit job also runs tiny generated LLM ONNX graphs on CPU (fp32, fp16); no real weights

real-cpu.when: weekly, on each published release, on demand, and on PRs touching the runtime (Real-model CPU validation)
real-cpu.runs: the pinned published model end to end on CPU (FLEURS fixtures and edge-case clips: CER ceilings, determinism, LLM stop reasons) plus the per-language FLEURS regression gate
real-cpu.command: OMNIASR_REAL_MODELS=1 python -m pytest tests/integration/test_real_models_cpu.py tests/integration/test_real_models_edge_cases.py && python tools/fleurs_eval.py run --model {family} --gate

gpu.when: on each published release and on demand, on a self-hosted GPU runner (CUDA and TensorRT release validation); manually on a CUDA machine before merging changes to GPU, precision, TensorRT or export code
gpu.runs: the pinned CTC model on every CUDA backend and precision: loading, dynamic lengths, CER ceilings and declared transcripts, repeated calls and cleanup; TensorRT engines of it on the FLEURS fixtures, edge-case clips and gate; ONNX CUDA precision agreement, WER and CER on a dataset you supply (reported, not gated)
gpu.command: OMNIASR_REAL_MODELS=1 python -m pytest tests/integration/test_real_models_gpu.py tests/integration/test_tensorrt_fleurs.py; python tools/evaluate_precisions.py --{family} <export> --device cuda --precision fp32 fp16 bf16 --dataset <eval.jsonl>; python tools/fleurs_eval.py run --model ctc --backend tensorrt --precision mixed --gate

release.when: once per model, when it is exported or republished
release.runs: the precision-agreement report published in the model card (measured with CUDA; tools/publish_precisions.py); for LLMs, step-by-step fp32 logit parity with fairseq2 on CPU and CUDA (tools/validate_llm_fairseq2.py)
release.command: python tools/evaluate_precisions.py --{family} <export> --device cuda --precision fp32 fp16 bf16 --audio <clips> --report <report>; python tools/publish_precisions.py {repo} <export> --report <report> [--upload]; for LLMs also python tools/validate_llm_fairseq2.py compare <reference> --directory <export> --device cpu|cuda

opt_in.description: Integration tests outside the scheduled tiers, run locally when their inputs are set (see CONTRIBUTING):

tests.tests/integration/test_onnx.py: a local CTC ONNX export (CPU fp32)
tests.tests/integration/test_tensorrt.py: a local TensorRT engine and its profile
tests.tests/integration/test_tensorrt_from_pre: TensorRT engines built from the Hub, default and custom profiles
tests.tests/integration/test_hub.py: Hub download, offline reuse and checksum failure
tests.tests/integration/test_llm.py: a local TorchScript LLM export (backend torch, CPU fp32)
tests.tests/integration/test_llm_cache_referen: the TorchScript explicit KV cache against its fairseq2 reference
